# export_touchstone

**Kind:** function

## Signature

```python
export_touchstone(sweep_results: 'Sequence[SParameterSweepResult]', ports: 'Sequence[PortDefinition]', *, output_dir: 'str | Path' = '.', output_path: 'str | Path | None' = None, write_csv_companion: 'bool' = True, allow_placeholder: 'bool' = False) -> 'Path'
```

## Docstring

```text
Write S-parameter sweeps to Touchstone 1.0 (RI format).

Data layout follows Touchstone 1.x ordering for each frequency point: a
2-port is ``S11 S21 S12 S22`` on one line; N >= 3 is listed row by row
(``S11 S12 ... S1N``, then ``S21 ...``), each matrix row starting a new
line and wrapped at four complex pairs per line. (Before `PORT-7` every N
was written column-major on one line, which a spec reader -- scikit-rf
2.1.0 -- reads as S^T for N >= 3.)

Parameters
----------
allow_placeholder:
    Required to export sweeps flagged ``is_placeholder``. Those S-matrices
    come from a hardcoded coupling heuristic rather than the solved field
    (see PORT-0/PORT-1), so the resulting ``.sNp`` file would look like
    authoritative simulation output while containing no electromagnetics.
    Export refuses by default; pass True only for format/round-trip testing,
    never to produce data for downstream tuning.
```
